definitions.explanation: Something that had subsided or been resolved coming back again. Used for disputes, controversies, diseases, and other issues that resurface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紛争|ふんそう}→紛争：05758_funsou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{再燃|さいねん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{再燃|さいねん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a possibility the debate will resurface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{再燃|さいねん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The incident has reignited calls for stronger regulations.

notes:
{再燃|さいねん} describes something that had subsided coming back — a dispute, disease, controversy, or public concern flaring up again.

FORMS:
⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (again) + {燃|ねん} (burn). The metaphor of fire reigniting captures the meaning: something thought to be settled resurfaces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{紛争|ふんそう}→紛争：05758_funsou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{再燃|さいねん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: conflict flares up again
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{再燃|さいねん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: debate resurfaces
- ⟦{懸念|けねん}→懸念：05622_kenen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{再燃|さいねん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: concerns resurface
- {再燃|さいねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恐|おそ}れ: fear of recurrence
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{再燃|さいねん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: disease recurs

REGISTER:
Primarily used in news reporting and formal writing. In casual speech, ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧ or ⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ would be more natural.

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{再発|さいはつ}→再発：09017_saihatsu⟧ focuses on recurrence of diseases or incidents. {再燃|さいねん} emphasizes the "flaring up" imagery and is preferred for conflicts and debates.
